criteria.source_quote: Male or female ≥ 40 years of age at the time of Randomization.

criteria.normalized_summary: A diagnosis of IPF within 7 years prior to Screening based on guidelines and HRCT consistent with UIP/probable UIP
criteria.source_quote: A diagnosis of IPF within 7 years prior to Screening, based on the 2022 ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT practice guideline as confirmed by the Investigator, and a centrally read screening HRCT consistent with usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) or probable UIP.
Percent predicted (pp) FVC ≥ 40% on Screening spirometry.

criteria.normalized_summary: Concurrent use of both nintedanib and pirfenidone therapy is prohibited
criteria.source_quote: Participants may enter the study whether or not they are receiving background nintedanib or pirfenidone therapy approved for the treatment of IPF, but not both concurrently.

criteria.normalized_summary: Must not have a history of non-IPF interstitial lung disease (ILD)
criteria.source_quote: Those with a history of interstitial lung disease (ILD) other than IPF are not eligible.

criteria.normalized_summary: Must not have pulmonary arterial hypertension requiring multi-drug therapy
criteria.source_quote: Those with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) requiring multi-drug therapy are not eligible.

criteria.normalized_summary: Must not have experienced an IPF exacerbation within 6 weeks of screening or during screening
criteria.source_quote: Those who have experienced an IPF exacerbation within 6 weeks of Screening, or during Screening, are not eligible.

criteria.normalized_summary: Patients must not have eGFR <= 30 ml/min/1.73 m2 or Child-Pugh Class B or C hepatic impairment.
criteria.source_quote: * Those with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) ≤ 30 ml/min/1.73 m2 (Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration \[CKD-EPI\] formula) (Inker 2021) or who have Child-Pugh Class B or C hepatic impairment are not eligible.

criteria.normalized_summary: Female participants must not be of childbearing potential.
criteria.source_quote: * Female participants must not be of childbearing potential.
